risk.rationale: F1 confirms a spearphishing email (T1566.002) was delivered to n.guler@aegean.edu (salary-slip/IBAN-update lure). This is a real initial-access signal, but the verified evidence stops at email delivery — there is no confirmed credential submission, successful suspicious authentication, mailbox/rule modification, or other account-takeover activity. Therefore "contain" (confirmed account takeover chain) is not met, and "benign" is not met because nothing has been explained away. With no conflicting evidence, this is best classified as a confirmed but isolated signal: watch the account for follow-on compromise behavior rather than escalate or contain.
